# graylog_pipeline_rule (Resource)

Manages a Graylog pipeline rule. Rules are written in the [Pipeline Rule Language](https://go2docs.graylog.org/current/making_sense_of_your_log_data/pipeline_rules.html) and referenced by pipelines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_pipeline_rule" "extract_fields" {
  source = <<-EOT
    rule "extract fields"
    when
      has_field("message")
    then
      set_field("processed", true);
    end
  EOT

  description = "Extract and set fields on messages"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) The rule source code.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the rule.
- `title` (String) The rule title. If omitted, Graylog parses it from the `source`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the rule was created.
- `id` (String) The pipeline rule ID.
- `modified_at` (String) Timestamp when the rule was last modified.
